title: Gantt chart (openjny-gantt-chart, version 4)
description: A Gantt chart: a tree of tasks with dates, dependencies and progress, plus saved versions. A parent task has "children" and takes its dates and progress from them; a leaf task has "start" and "duration". Durations count working days (the weekly days off, Saturday and Sunday by default, and the project's holidays are off, unless the project works that day). The project can define properties (extra fields such as hours, a category or a link): a task holds the values in "props", keyed by the name of the property. Besides this schema, the program checks that ids are unique, that every predecessor exists, that no task is its own predecessor, that the dependencies have no cycle, and that every value in "props" suits its property. Version 3 files (which had the fields "estimate" and "actual" on tasks) and version 2 files are read as version 4: the hours become number properties.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so that editors can validate and complete the file.

tasks.description: The top-level tasks in display order (at most 2000 tasks in all, nested at most 9 levels deep).

versions.description: Saved versions: named copies of the project settings and tasks that can be restored.

color.description: Color label of the bar. Left out, the task takes the color of its parent, or blue when no parent has one. A parent's color is the default for the tasks under it.

propertyDefinition.description: A property the project adds to its tasks.

name.description: Unique in the project. It is the key of the values in a task's "props".

type.description: What a value is: number (a number), text (up to 500 characters), date (YYYY-MM-DD), select (one of the options), tags (up to 20 words), checkbox (true, or left out), url (http or https).

options.description: The choices of a select property.

unit.description: Shown after the numbers of a number property (h, $...).

aggregate.description: For a number property: a parent task shows the sum (or the average, minimum, maximum) of the leaf tasks under it instead of a value of its own.

values.description: The values of the properties the task has, keyed by the name of the property: a number, a string, a date string, a string array (tags) or true (checkbox). What a task has no value for is left out. A parent holds no value for a property that adds up the tasks under it.

weeklyOff.description: The weekdays that are off every week. Leave it out for the default, Saturday and Sunday. At least one weekday must be a working day.

holidays.description: Days off besides the weekly days off.

extraWorkdays.description: Days that are worked although they would be off (a weekly day off). A day that is in both this list and holidays counts as worked. Leave it out when there are none.

weekStart.description: The day weeks start on in the timeline.

properties.description: The properties the project adds to its tasks, in the order they are shown. Leave it out when there are none.

dependency.description: The task cannot start before the next working day after the predecessor's end, plus lag working days: a predecessor only pushes the task later, it never pulls it earlier.

lag.description: Working days to keep between the end of the predecessor and the start of the task (0 or more: a task cannot start before its predecessors end).

task.description: A parent task (it has "children") or a leaf task.

start.description: The day the task starts. If its predecessors end later, it starts on the first day they allow instead (and this is rewritten to that day).

milestone.description: A point in time shown as a diamond; its duration is 1.

due.description: Deadline. The task is marked late when it ends after this day.

collapsed.description: Hide the children in the list.

due.description: Deadline. The parent is marked late when its last child ends after this day.
